import random, time
def valid5b(st):
    ch,a15,b15,a12,b12 = st
    r,c=ch
    if not(5<=r<=52) or not(2<=c<=64-21): return False
    for (rr,cc,w) in ((a15[0],a15[1],15),(b15[0],b15[1],15),(a12[0],a12[1],12),(b12[0],b12[1],12)):
        if not(5<=rr<=52) or cc<2 or cc+w-1>61: return False
    obs=objs5(*st); seen=set()
    for (r0,c0,w) in obs:
        cells=clZ(r0,r0+2,c0,c0+w-1)
        if seen & cells: return False
        seen |= cells
    fixed = clZ(2,7,23,25) | clZ(53,58,8,16) | clZ(53,58,26,34) | clZ(53,58,38,46) | clZ(53,58,50,58)
    return not (seen & fixed)
def obj5b(st, pm=300, ph=300):
    if not valid5b(st): return 10**6
    rr=sim4P(objs5(*st), st[0])
    return (4-len(rr[1]))*pm + len(rr[0])*ph
CUR5=((20,20),(17,23),(23,38),(29,41),(35,29))
best=(obj5b(CUR5), CUR5)
t0=time.time()
r=random.Random(3)
for restart in range(6):
    st=list(CUR5) if restart==0 else [ (r.randrange(5,53,3), r.randrange(2,44,3)) if i==0 else (r.randrange(5,53,3), r.randrange(2,48,3)) for i in range(5)]
    cs=obj5b(tuple(st))
    T=250.0
    for it in range(1400):
        if time.time()-t0 > 24: break
        T=max(5.0, 250.0*(1-it/1400))
        i=r.randrange(5)
        rr,cc=st[i]
        nr=max(5,min(52, rr+3*r.choice([-2,-1,1,2])))
        nc=max(2,min(61, cc+3*r.choice([-2,-1,1,2])))
        lst=list(st); lst[i]=(nr,nc); s2=obj5b(tuple(lst))
        if s2<=cs or r.random()<pow(2.71828, (cs-s2)/T):
            st,cs=lst,s2
            if cs<best[0]: best=(cs,tuple(st))
    if time.time()-t0>24: break
